overview: Oceanides coordinates property services for homes, condominiums and company facilities. Our offering covers siphoning, plumbing, renovation and restoration, pest control and sewage treatment plant (STP) projects.
delivery: Oceanides remains your main contact from the initial inquiry to turnover. We coordinate the site assessment, quotation and service delivery, including specialist contractors where the work requires them.
